first.rationale: The competitor's entry pricing creates an immediate threat in the price-sensitive SMB segment, where promotional pricing is the most directly evidenced response. A small guarded test can assess qualified revenue, margin, and downstream retention rather than assuming acquisition lift is sustainable. Verify pricing evidence first because it is most consequential; verify onboarding evidence because completion is also declining and it is the strongest alternative use of the single slot.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% decline in completion, and the verified source record showed materially higher completion, faster time-to-value, and a 3% improvement in 30-day retention—evidence aligned with sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: although it lifted short-term qualified revenue, the verified 12% retention decline means it is not a sustainable-growth response.
